thread:
Maria: customer reporting spikes of 502s on /v1/generate and intermittent 429s on /v1/embeddings after yesterday's canary. have request ids and a curl repro but need guidance on what to collect.
Raj: can you paste a curl and a couple req ids? also were they pinned to a model/version or using rollout?
Maria: not pinned, rollout to redwood-large-v1:2.1 canary happened last night. sample curl: 
```\ncurl -i -X POST \"https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate\" \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","input":"Hello","max_tokens":50}'\n```
example reqids: req-0a1b2c3d, req-0f4e5d6c, req-0fffaaaa. 429 payload shows \"quota_exceeded\" for embeddings route, 502 shows \"runtime_error\" in body.
Sylvia: DeployBot logged a canary promotion around 04:12 UTC, maybe related. @DeployBot can you paste the deploy event? :thinking:
DeployBot: canary-deploy event: model=redwood-large-v1, from=2.0 -> to=2.1 (canary, 10% traffic) at 2025-09-14T04:12:08Z.
Raj: ok. we need proxy logs and runtime traces for those reqids, plus a debug bundle. please run the support debug-collector and include the three reqids and the time window +/- 2m. also capture headerrouting and quota counters.
Maria: grabbing logs now, quick trace snippet for req-0a1b2c3d: 
```\n[proxy] INFO handle_req req=req-0a1b2c3d path=/v1/generate upstream=canary-rt-17 status=502 latency_ms=382 message=runtime_error
[runtime] ERROR invoke req=req-0a1b2c3d worker=wt-5 trace=kvcache-miss fallback=none exc=segmentation_fault\n```
Raj: that runtime exc looks bad. also the 429s on embeddings could be a quota enforcement path running on a different service (no fallback). can you run: 
```\ncurl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.com/v1/support/debug-bundle\" \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \n  -d '{"req_ids":["req-0a1b2c3d","req-0f4e5d6c","req-0fffaaaa"],"window_s":240}'\n```
and attach the resulting bundle link here.
Maria: started bundle collection, coming in ~2m. also noticed customer hit billing quota bump earlier today — could be correlated with the 429s.
Tim: quick thought — if canary introduced a kernel or quantization change it might crash certain worker shapes causing the 502s, while quota config change could explain 429s. temporary mitigation: pin affected customer to stable (2.0) so they avoid canary runtime. to pin: 
```\ncurl -X PATCH \"https://api.redwood.com/v1/admin/rollout/redwood-large-v1\" \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"pin_overrides": [{"customer_id":"cust-4521","version":"2.0"}] }'\n```
Raj: good. also if we need an immediate rollback of the canary we can decrease weight. example: 
```\nPATCH /v1/admin/rollout/redwood-large-v1 {"canary_weight":0}\n```
Maria: debug bundle link: https://storage.redwood/internal/debug-bundles/db-1954321000.tgz (uploaded). attaching logs and the curl outputs.
SupportBot: debug bundle db-1954321000.tgz received and queued for analysis. ticket #SUP-7721 created.
Sylvia: thanks — I'll coordinate with runtime team to check kernel/quantization diffs between 2.0 and 2.1. @Tim can you own the pin/rollback if suport confirms? :thumbsup:
Tim: will do. I'll apply the pin for cust-4521 and then run a smoke test on generation + embeddings. posting confirmation when complete.
Maria: thanks everyone, customer updated and waiting on ETA. I'll paste any additional reqids if they show up. :pray:
